smoothing hand cream

90% ingredients of natural origin

Moisturises, nourishes and softens the skin. Visibly smooths and reduces skin roughness. Moisturised, nourished and  regenerated  and smoothed hand skin.

How to use

Massage into clean hands. Use every day.

INCI

Aqua (Water), Ethylhexyl Stearate, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate, Stearyl Alcohol, Urea, Glycerin, Hexyl Laurate, Sodium Lactate, Dimethicone, Lecithin, Ubiquinone, Astrocaryum Vulgare Kernel Oil, Tocopherol, Cera Alba (Beeswax), Stearic Acid, Carbomer, Xanthan Gum, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Parfum (Fragrance), Linalool, Geraniol, Hexyl Cinnamal, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Limonene, Lactic Acid, Sodium Hydroxide.
 
The list of ingredients is consistent with the current state of manufacture as of 2020-10.

 

MAIN INGREDIENTS

coenzyme Q10, urea, sodium lactate, tucuma butter
